title: Nethelurgy
description: Improves upon the Nether by adding new ores, resources and more
body:
![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1285898/description_44810be2-3e7d-411f-a662-e742521521be.png)

# Overview:

Nethelurgy is a mod that expands upon the mining and progression aspects of the Nether by adding 2 new resources: Tungsten and Ignite.

Tungsten has fire resitance properties and can be used to create a tier of equipment between Iron and Diamond, used to make Tungsten Bolts - a new crossbow projectile, or crafted with any tool or armor to make it immune to fire.

Ignite is primarily used as a fuel source, but can also be used to create a variety of fire-related items such as Blaze Powder or the Firebomb - a new TNT variant that ignites blocks and entities.

The mod also adds some miscellaneous content such as: Searing - a new treasure enchantment that automatically smelts mined blocks, Potions of Decay - potions that give the wither effect, 2 new Overworld ores to the Nether (Basalt Iron and Blackstone Diamond ores) and more.

 

# Compatibility:

[**Create**](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) - compatibility recipes, crushed raw tungsten

[**Quark**](https://modrinth.com/mod/quark) - compatibility recipes, raw tungsten bricks, hoe harvesting

[**Spelunkery**](https://modrinth.com/mod/spelunkery) - compatibility recipes, raw tungsten nugget

[**Farmer's Delight**](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight) - tungsten knife

[**Clayworks**](https://modrinth.com/mod/clayworks) - decorated pot trim textures

[**Oreganized**](https://modrinth.com/mod/oreganized) - tungsten bolt crate
